_doc: Recipes: what a processing building makes. `building` names the type that runs it; `inputs` are taken from the store when a batch starts (fuel included -- wood burned to charcoal heat), `outputs` go to the store when it ends, so nothing appears without something consumed and work done. `seconds` is the work, `cooldown` the wait after (the crucible cooling, a world rule), `batch` how many runs one charge holds (research can add). A recipe with `default` true is known from the start; others open through research ({kind: recipe}).
